heading_en: Exposures Relating to the Portion of Specified Items Not Included in Adjustment Items
summary_ja: 特定項目のうち調整項目に算入されなかった部分のエクスポージャーに二百五十パーセントのリスク・ウェイトを適用する。
summary_en: Applies a 250% risk weight to exposures relating to the portion of specified items not included in the Common Equity Tier 1 adjustment items.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding Articles 129 through the preceding Article, for an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the exposure relating to the portion of specified items that was not included in the amount of adjustment items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the formula in Article 2, item (i) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of that exposure (meaning EAD) by a risk weight of 250%.
